# JRank Law Library

> > Comprehensive free legal encyclopedia covering American law, constitutional rights, Supreme Court cases, and legal terminology from A-Z.

JRank Law Library provides extensive coverage of U.S. legal concepts, landmark Supreme Court decisions, notable trials spanning from 1918 to 1994, and detailed explanations of legal terms across criminal law, civil rights, securities law, tax law, and constitutional law. The resource includes biographical information on key justices like William H. Rehnquist, Harry A. Blackmun, and William J. Brennan, Jr., alongside analysis of foundational cases and amendments.

## Key Topics

- U.S. Supreme Court
- First Amendment
- Fourteenth Amendment
- Constitutional Law
- Civil Rights
- Criminal Law
- Securities Law (SEC, Securities Act of 1933, Securities Exchange Act of 1934)
- Section 1983
- Employment Law
- Tax Law
- Roe v. Wade
- Notable Trials
- Legal Definitions and Terminology
- William H. Rehnquist
- Harry A. Blackmun

## Home

- [Law Library - American Law and Legal Information](http://law.jrank.org): Homepage for JRank legal encyclopedia and case law library

## Notable Trials and Court Cases

- [Notable Trials and Court Cases - 1918 to 1940](http://law.jrank.org/collection/61/Notable-Trials-Court-Cases-1918-1940.html): Historical criminal cases 1918-1940 including Black Sox Trial
- [Notable Trials and Court Cases - 1963 to 1972](http://law.jrank.org/collection/64/Notable-Trials-Court-Cases-1963-1972.html): Notable trials 1963-1972 including Abington v. Schempp
- [Notable Trials and Court Cases - 1989 to 1994](http://law.jrank.org/collection/67/Notable-Trials-Court-Cases-1989-1994.html): Notable trials 1989-1994 covering constitutional and civil rights cases

## Constitutional and Civil Rights Law

- [Roberts v. United States Jaycees to Secretary of State](http://law.jrank.org/collection/237/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Roberts-v-United-States-Jaycees-Secretary-State.html): Supreme Court cases including Roberts v. U.S. Jaycees civil rights
- [Directed Verdict to Do Not Attempt Resuscitation order](http://law.jrank.org/collection/209/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Directed-Verdict-Do-Attempt-Resuscitation-order-DNAR-order.html): Legal encyclopedia on disability law including ADA and IDEA

## Securities and Financial Law

- [Secretary to SHAs](http://law.jrank.org/collection/238/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Secretary-SHAs.html): Legal encyclopedia covering securities law, SEC, and Section 1983
- [Indirect evidence to Internal Revenue Code](http://law.jrank.org/collection/219/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Indirect-evidence-Internal-Revenue-Code.html): Legal encyclopedia on IRAs, IWW labor union, and tax code

## Criminal and Civil Procedure

- [Deed of covenant to Direct Tax](http://law.jrank.org/collection/208/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Deed-covenant-Direct-Tax.html): Legal encyclopedia on defamation, DOD, and deed covenants
- [Ex proprio motu (ex mero motu) to File](http://law.jrank.org/collection/213/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Ex-proprio-motu-ex-mero-motu-File.html): Legal encyclopedia covering extradition, extortion, and FICA
- [Recovered memory to Repugnancy](http://law.jrank.org/collection/235/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Recovered-memory-Repugnancy.html): Legal encyclopedia on referendum, redlining, and judicial procedures

## Tax and Employment Law

- [Taking at sea to Tonkin Gulf Resolution](http://law.jrank.org/collection/242/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Taking-at-sea-Tonkin-Gulf-Resolution.html): Legal encyclopedia on tax law, Tammany Hall, and judicial ethics
- [Companies House to Constituency](http://law.jrank.org/collection/204/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Companies-House-Constituency.html): Legal encyclopedia covering employment law and compensatory damages
- [Strategic Health Authorities to Taking a conveyance without consent](http://law.jrank.org/collection/241/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Strategic-Health-Authorities-SHAs-Taking-conveyance-without-consent-TWOC.html): Legal encyclopedia on labor law, strict liability, and strikes

## Legal Encyclopedia A-Z

- [Approximation of laws to Autopsy](http://law.jrank.org/collection/197/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Approximation-laws-Autopsy.html): Legal encyclopedia covering arbitration and legal terminology A-Z
- [Purge to Recovered Assets Incentivization Fund](http://law.jrank.org/collection/234/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Purge-Recovered-Assets-Incentivization-Fund-RAIF.html): Legal encyclopedia covering contract law and Latin legal terms
- [Coagulation to Companies House](http://law.jrank.org/collection/203/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Coagulation-Companies-House.html): Legal encyclopedia featuring biographies and federal regulations
- [Robert Lee Carter - Further Readings to Child Molestation](http://law.jrank.org/collection/201/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Robert-Lee-Carter-Further-Readings-Child-Molestation.html): Legal encyclopedia covering case method and legal education
- [National Environmental Policy Act to Notice](http://law.jrank.org/collection/227/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-National-Environmental-Policy-Act-1969-Notice.html): Legal encyclopedia on NEPA, NFIB, and National Firearms Act
- [Vest to Water Rights](http://law.jrank.org/collection/245/Free-Legal-Encyclopedia-Vest-Water-Rights.html): Legal encyclopedia on veterans affairs, veto power, and water rights
